definitions: A flight on an airplane that departs late at night and arrives early in the morning.
A condition of the eyes in which they appear red, often due to irritation, fatigue, or illness.
The phenomenon in photography where subjects' eyes appear red in flash photographs due to light reflecting off the retina.
examples: I took the red-eye from Los Angeles to New York.
He had a terrible red-eye after working all night.
The red-eye in the photo ruined the shot.
